thread:
sophia: Quick kickoff — we need a lightweight partner blueprint that combines Terraform infra + GitOps Helm chart for CloudPartnerX marketplace. Goal: publish a single repo with examples for GCP and AWS, plus a minimal on-prem hint.
raj: SGTM. who owns the terraform module? I can take infra and CI bits.
luke: I can do the Helm chart and GitOps overlay. plan to use ArgoCD examples.
emily: Need a short checklist for security review and marketplace packaging. I can draft the checklist.
sophia: Awesome. timeline wise, target docs + sample repo by next Tue (8 business days). Can we split tasks?
raj: I'll create terraform module skeleton under /modules/cloudpartnerx-network and wire up vars.
raj: Quick snippet for module layout i suggest:
```
modules/cloudpartnerx-network/
  main.tf
  outputs.tf
  variables.tf
  examples/simple/
```
luke: For Helm, will create chart with values for nodeAffinity + tolerations to support dedicated node pools.
luke: Example helm install command for testing: `helm upgrade --install cp-demo ./chart -f values-gcp.yaml`
ana: tagging in ana for docs / partner comms — @ana can you coordinate marketplace metadata?
ana: @sophia can you confirm whether we need an official Redwood reference arch badge or just partner listing?
sophia: Partner listing first, badge later. Keep docs neutral and vendor-agnostic, highlight network/security notes.
emily: I'll add security checklist items: IAM least-priv, KMS usage, private endpoints, VPC peering notes.
raj: CI idea: terraform fmt/check + `tflint` in CI, then terragrunt plan for examples. I'll add a GitHub Actions workflow.
raj: sample workflow lines:
```yaml
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  lint:
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: tflint
```
luke: For GitOps demo will include a minimal argocd Application manifest and a README with deploy steps.
deploy-bot: build triggered for repo:cloudpartnerx-blueprint — status: queued :hourglass: (auto message)
emily: Docs owner: @emily, Infra owner: @raj, Chart owner: @luke, PM: @sophia, Partner comms: @ana. I'll make an ownership table in the README.
sophia: Nice. Next sync Thursday 10am PT to review first pass. Please link PRs to this thread. :thumbsup:
ana: Noted. I'll draft a partner announcement checklist once we have screenshots and testing matrix.
raj: Starting module PR today, will ping here when ready for review.
luke: I'll scaffold helm chart and sample overlay this afternoon.
emily: I'll start the security checklist doc and post initial version here.
sophia: Great work team — let's aim for a clean, small example that partners can copy quickly.
